name: Serene Precipio
summary:
Treatment days are long. Serene makes them lighter.
Serene VR is a clinically informed virtual reality experience designed specifically for people undergoing chemotherapy infusion. Developed in partnership with Precipio — a leader in cancer diagnostics — Serene brings research-backed immersive distraction directly to the infusion chair.
What Serene offers:
